newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Sammi Group shares fall on trouble talk.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Sammi Group shares fall on trouble talk.

text.p: Shares in Sammi Corp and Sammi Steel Co Ltd fell in active Thursday morning trading on rumours that Sammi Corp had missed the first deadline for repayment of debt, brokers said.
A Sammi Corp executive denied the rumours.
Sammi Corp fell 170 won to its lower limit of 2,040, and Sammi Steel fell 320 won to its limit of 3,700.
"It's true that we missed the first deadline for debt repayments two days ago, but we were able to make up for it the very next day," the Sammi executive told Reuters.

Banking shares were also hit by the rumours. The sector sub-index fell 3.8 percent to 356.19. Commercial Bank of Korea fell 390 won to its limit of 4,590, SEOULBANK lost 210 won to 3,600 and Korea First Bank declined 150 won to 3,420.
